decision.title: Having Fun with Elvis on Stage (1974)

input.title: Having Fun with Elvis on Stage (1974)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (2 tracks) per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Having_Fun_with_Elvis_on_Stage, https://www.discogs.com/release/3460639-Elvis-Presley-Having-Fun-With-Elvis-On-Stage. 1974 spoken-word 'talking album' of on-stage banter, snippets spliced from 1969-1972 concert tapes with all music edited out. Officially banded as just two untitled tracks: Side A (18:06) and Side B (19:00). Originally released on Colonel Tom Parker's Boxcar Enterprises label (sold only at performances), picked up by RCA Victor (CPM1-0818/APM1-0818). Deleted at Presley's request; remains unavailable on CD. Recorded per task as the official banded titles, not song titles (none exist).
